answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 62406 Country: DE Title: Taking knowledge from a fasiq Question: Is it allowed to take knowledge in 'aqidah or fiqh from a da'i or mudarris who shaves or trims his beard, does not cover his head and wears fashionable clothes? Answer ID: 62406 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 109/92/N=02/1437) It is makrooh and undesired to seek Islamic knowledge from such a preacher or teacher who trims beard or keeps it less than one fist or does not cover his head and wears fashionable clothes. As the religious sciences does not only aim at knowledge rather their key purpose is firmness in practice and belief. Thus if the teacher does not keep Shariah appearance and tends towards fashionable things then it might affect the students. Hence one must learn the knowledge of religion and Shariah from practicing Muslim. Muhammad Ibn Seereen, Allah have mercy upon him, writes in Muqaddama Muslim Sharif (p 11): إن هذا العلم دين فانظرو ا عمن تأخذون دينكم. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
